description: Returns the endpoint, price and payment method of the optional paid hosted check. It does not call the API and does not pay or sign anything. The paid check reads the sending wallet's real transfer history on Ethereum and Base (optionally Avalanche), finds poisoning transfers (zero-value, dust or fake-token transfers from lookalike addresses) and returns a verdict ok | caution | danger, the address you probably meant, and evidence transaction hashes. It costs 0.005 USDC on Base via x402. Use it when you have no trusted address list to pass to check_recipient_lookalike, or when check_recipient_lookalike returns unknown for a recipient copied from transaction history. Returns: method, url_template, price_usdc, network, asset, protocol, chains, settles and docs.
name: onchain_check_info
title: How to buy the on-chain poisoning check
